name: Prometheus exporter
description: Serves this host's metrics (and, on a fleet master, every node's status) at /metrics in Prometheus text format, with a ready-made Grafana dashboard.

listen.title: Listen address
listen.description: host:port the /metrics endpoint binds to. Use 0.0.0.0:9469 to expose it beyond this host, and set a bearer token when you do.

bearer_token.title: Bearer token
bearer_token.description: When set, scrapes must send Authorization: Bearer <token>.

include_fleet.title: Include fleet nodes
include_fleet.description: On a fleet master, also export per-node up, CPU, memory and disk series.
